delivery:index:SourceTrigger.description: Limits the pushes that start a run.

paths.description: Glob patterns of changed files. A push starts a run only when it changes a file that matches.

delivery:index:StacksEntry.description: One target stack that a Stacks resource updates.

config.description: Config values that Delivery sets on the target stack before the update. Values are plain strings, and Delivery rejects secret values. Keep secrets in the config file of the target stack or in an ESC environment.

directory.description: Directory of the stack project, relative to the repository root.

environment.description: Environment variables for the update, for example cloud credentials. A secret value stays secret. The names PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN and PULUMI_BACKEND_URL, and all names that start with DELIVERY_, are reserved.

runtime.description: Pool that runs the update. The preview runs on the hosted pool only, so omit it.

source.description: VCS source to check out. The update uses the commit of the run for this source.

stack.description: Target stack as organization/project/stack. It must exist before the first run, in the organization of the pipeline.

timeout.description: Maximum run time of the update in seconds. The default is 7200 (2 hours).

delivery:index:WebhookSigning.description: How the service verifies a post to a webhook source.

kind.description: Kind of signature: hmac-sha256 (an HMAC over the raw body) or token (a shared secret).

secret.description: Secret that the external system signs with. It stays secret.

delivery:index:WorkflowsRuntimeArgs.description: Pool selection. The preview runs on the hosted pool only.

agentPool.description: Pool identifier. Returned unchanged as the ref of the resource.

result.description: Typed result of the task, as the result schema describes it. It is unknown until the task has run.

taskId.description: Identifier of the task in Pulumi Cloud. It is unknown until the task has started.

agent.description: Name of the Custom Agent definition in the organization.

prompt.description: Prompt of the task. Build it from the outputs of other members with apply.

resultSchema.description: JSON Schema that the typed result of the task must satisfy. Omit it for a result without a fixed shape.

source.description: VCS source of the repository that the agent works in. The agent gets the commit of the run for this source.

stage.description: Stage that the task runs in. A pipeline requires it.

timeout.description: Maximum run time as a Go duration, such as 30m.

value.description: Value to publish. It can be any value, also a secret or a structure.

trigger.description: Starts a run on a push to the branch. Set true for every push, or { paths } for pushes that change a matching file. Omit it for a source that is part of the release but never starts a run.

delivery:index:Job.description:
Declares a command that a run executes in a stage. The service checks out the source at the commit of the run and runs the command in directory.

A resource that is not a Delivery resource waits for the job when it uses an output of the job.

The command sees these variables: DELIVERY_RELEASE, DELIVERY_RUN, DELIVERY_STAGE, DELIVERY_COMMIT and DELIVERY_PIPELINE. To publish outputs, the command writes a JSON object to the file that DELIVERY_OUTPUTS names. Each key is one output. The file can be at most 1 MiB. To mark an output as secret, write it as {"value": ..., "secret": true}.

If any output is secret, the whole map is secret. An output is secret when the job marks it or when it contains a secret environment value.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as delivery from "@pulumi/delivery";

new delivery.Job("smoke", {
    stage: prod,
    source: code,
    directory: "delivery",
    command: "./scripts/smoke.sh",
});
```

outputs.description: Outputs that the command wrote. They are unknown until the job has run.

command.description: Command to run. It runs with sh -c. The command can write outputs to the file that DELIVERY_OUTPUTS names.

directory.description: Directory to run the command in, relative to the repository root.

environment.description: Environment variables for the command. A secret value stays secret. The names PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN and PULUMI_BACKEND_URL, and all names that start with DELIVERY_, are reserved.

stage.description: Stage that the job runs in. A pipeline requires it.

timeout.description: Maximum run time as a Go duration, such as 30m. The preview does not apply this value yet. A job stops after 2 hours.

data.description: Fields of the issue: identifier, title, description, url, state, labels, team and action. They are unknown during registration and preview.

ref.description: Identifier of the source, as webhook:<name>.

subject.description: Id of the issue of the post that started the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

url.description: URL to point the Linear webhook at.

version.description: When the issue changed. It is unknown during registration and preview.

ignoreBots.description: Ignores a change that an app or an integration made rather than a user. The default is true.

labels.description: Names of labels that must all be on the issue. Omit it to accept issues with any labels.

signingSecret.description: Signing secret of the Linear webhook. It stays secret.

states.description: Names of states, one of which the issue must be in. Omit it to accept issues in any state.

releaseNumber.description: Number of the release of the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

program.description: Source and directory of the pipeline program.

artifacts.description: Artifacts of the release, by name.

releaseNumber.description: Number of the release that the stage of the upstream pipeline deployed.

runNumber.description: Number of the run of the upstream pipeline that converged the stage.

trigger.description: Set true to start a run of this pipeline when the stage deploys a new release. Omit it for a source that is part of the release but never starts a run.

outputs.description: Outputs of each entry, by entry name. They are unknown until the group has run.

stacks.description: Entries by name. Names can use letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. Each entry updates one target stack.

stage.description: Stage that the group runs in. A pipeline requires it.

from.description: Upstream stages. Omit for an entry stage.

pipeline.description: Pipeline that the stage belongs to.

when.description: Optional rule that must pass before the release enters this stage.

data.description: Data that the map expression yielded for the post that started the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

ref.description: Identifier of the source, as webhook:<name>.

subject.description: Subject that the map expression yielded for the post that started the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

url.description: URL where the external system posts. It is <backend>/api/preview/delivery/webhooks/<organization>/<project>/<pipeline stack>/<name>.

version.description: Version that the map expression yielded for the post that started the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

map.description: JMESPath expression over the JSON body of a post. It must yield an object { subject: string, version: string, data: object }.

signing.description: How the service verifies a post. Omit it for a source that accepts every post.

trigger.description: Starts a run on a matching post. The default is true. Set false for a source that is part of the release but never starts a run.

when.description: JMESPath expression over the JSON body of a post. A post starts a run only when it is truthy. Omit it to accept every post.
